progression.narrative: The performance opens on Cs4 and dwells most on D in Naghmeh-e Maghlub. The line peaks at F4 (345.6 Hz) at 1:03.3. It closes on Bk3, not the tonic (E4 → E4 → E4 → Bk3 → Bk3 → Bk3).
